event.text: He uses AlphaGo Zero as an example of the “blessings of scale”: stacking more layers and training a larger model on a richer signal helped it reach superhuman Go play without search. His broader point is that scaling can bring out abilities without building them in by hand.

event.text: He thinks predicting text forces a model to learn what the writing reflects about the world—like language, cause and effect, and common sense—because those help it predict better. As the easy patterns run out, the model has to move beyond memorized or surface-level shortcuts toward more general reasoning.
